1: // Simple Canvas Meteor Dodge game
2: // The HTML contains <canvas id="game"></canvas>

4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return; // safety
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Audio setup
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   function playBeep(freq = 440, duration = 0.1) {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.type = 'square';
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     osc.start();
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:   }
21: 
22:   // Set canvas size (fallback if not set in HTML)
23:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
24:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
25:   // Create starfield background
26:   const stars = [];
27:   for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
28:     stars.push({
29:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
30:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
31:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
32:     });
33:   }

35:   const ship = {

43:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false };

45:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true;

49:   });

53:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
54:   let lastTime = 0;
55:   let score = 0;

57:   const maxHits = 3;
58: 
59:   // Ensure audio can play after user interaction
60: function ensureAudio(){

62: }
63: window.addEventListener('keydown', ensureAudio);
64: window.addEventListener('mousedown', ensureAudio);

66: function spawnMeteor() {
67:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
68:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - radius * 2) + radius;
69:     const speed = 1 + score * 0.02; // accelerate with score
70:     meteors.push({ x, y: -radius, r: radius, speed });

73:   function update(dt) {
74:     // Ship movement
75:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
76:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
77:     // Keep within bounds
78:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w, ship.x));
79:

82:     if (spawnTimer > spawnInterval) {
83:       spawnTimer = 0;

87:       const m = meteors[i];
